name: AIDialog
description: Primary user-to-AI message entry — full card (AIInputCard) with Add, Skill, Mode, Mic, Send; slim pill (AIDialogSlim) for compact surfaces. Shared border state machine: neutral → focus-blue → filled-purple.
intent: Message composer for AI Command Center and chat surfaces. Not a search field — preserves AI-specific affordances (skills, mode, mic).

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.note: Full card: Add, Skills, Agent (AIDialogButton), Mic (AIDialogButton), Send (gradient). Slim uses combined Add/Mode.

props.name: onSend
props.hint: Called with trimmed message text on submit

props.name: chatMode
props.hint: Smaller border-radius (AI.radius.md) for pinned chat variant

notes: Full card: Ghost AIDialogButton toolbar (Add, Skills, Agent, Mic) + gradient Send
Slim pill: AIDialogSlim — 56px height, combined Add/Mode menu, Mic/Send toggle
Border state machine: empty → focused → filled using ai-input.border.* tokens
Built-in menus: Add (files/project/skills), Skills picker, Mode (Agent/Plan/Ask)
Send button: ArrowRight icon in circular 32px control — not SendHorizontal

requiredAttributes: Accessible names on Mic, Add, and Mode controls

forbiddenUsage: Do not use as a generic search input
Do not strip Add or Mode controls without design review
Do not substitute standard Field or Textarea
Do not hardcode border/shadow values — use ai-input.* and ai-send.* tokens
Do not skip border state machine transitions
Do not use plain icon buttons in toolbar — use AIDialogButton Ghost
